Support

Contact

Questions, bug reports and suggestions are welcome. Developer: Shimayu.

Contact us on GitHub

GitHub Issues are public. Do not include personal information such as your name, contact details or current location. A GitHub account is required to post.

Frequently asked questions

Train positions are missing or not updating.

Check your connection and the selected line. Train positions are retrieved at intervals and may differ from actual positions. Trains may not appear on lines or sections without data, or outside operating hours.

Do I need to allow location access?

Location is used to find nearby stations. Change access in iPhone Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services. You can select stations and lines manually without allowing location access.

Departure times differ from actual departures.

Timetable and delay updates can cause differences. Extra services and schedule changes may not appear immediately. When travelling, follow station departure boards and staff guidance.

The widget shows outdated information.

The widget uses station departure information saved by the iPhone app. Open the station in the iPhone app, then check the widget. iOS controls refresh timing, so widget information may not always be current.

Information is not loading on Apple Watch.

Check your Watch's internet connection and reopen the app. If you use location features, check location permissions on the Watch too. If the problem continues, contact us with your device, OS version and steps to reproduce it.

Is this an official railway app?

No. This is an independent app developed by Shimayu. Please contact the developer, rather than railway or transit operators, about app issues or how to use it.

Reporting a problem

To help us investigate, include as much of the following as you can.

  • App name and version
  • Device model and iOS or watchOS version
  • Date and time, and the affected line or station
  • Steps taken, expected behaviour and what actually happened
  • Screenshots if possible, with personal information hidden

How information is handled

this app's privacy policy for more information.
